review_text: The new update is incredibly fast. I love the dark mode feature!
I was charged a $50 early withdrawal fee without any warning. This feels like a scam.
Customer support was great. Sarah helped me reset my password quickly.
The app keeps crashing when I try to view my portfolio on iOS 17.
It's an okay app, but I wish there were more options for setting up recurring deposits.
Absolutely seamless onboarding experience. Highly recommend to everyone!
Why is there an early withdrawal charge when I moved my funds to a different account?
UI is intuitive, but sometimes the charts take a few seconds to load.
